dialogDescription: Getting started and downloading the models
welcomeTagline: Transcribe your meetings live, with Catalan at the heart.

live.title: See the text as you talk
live.text: Murmur transcribes the meeting in real time, with full support for Catalan. You can follow it, correct it and annotate it as it happens.

speakers.title: Who's talking and what you jot down
speakers.text: It tells voices apart and shows you who spoke and for how long. The notes you write are tied to the exact minute of the meeting.

cover.title: The meeting, summed up
cover.text: When it ends, Murmur prepares a summary with the title, main points, decisions and tasks. Each point links to the moment it was said.

indicator.title: The call, always in view
indicator.text: While you record, a small bar sits on the edge of the screen, over the call. One click captures what's being shared, and the screenshot shows up in the summary, at the minute it was taken.

alerts.title: Never miss recording a meeting
alerts.text: When Zoom, Meet or Teams use the microphone, Murmur lets you know from the menu bar. One click and it starts recording.

demo.liveText: So if everyone's happy with it, we'll finalize the budget on Thursday and send it on Friday
demo.livePartial: to the client so they can

models.introReady: You can now record your first meeting.
models.introDownloading: The download continues even if you close this window.
models.introChoose: Murmur works with models that run on this Mac. You only need to download them once.
models.transcriptionText: Turns speech into text, in Catalan and other languages, right on this Mac.
models.offline: Once downloaded, they work offline. Meeting audio and text never leave this computer.
models.summaryText: Title, summary, decisions and tasks for each meeting. Choose who writes them:
